what: the original CALMET 6.5.0 surface-station observation assembly and upper-air columns for the frozen Hefei 2022 case, exported by write-only instrumentation
why: P6D's round-17 request: level 1 of U/V is the observed surface wind, so no SIMILT is involved and the EL/ZII tables cannot move it; separating the assembly, the UA low-level interpolation and the analysis weights needs the values before CALMET analyses them

1.when: PREPDI: the surface station column as it enters the analysis (level 1 only; the rest are the EDIT missing value)

2.when: DIAGNO: the same column after the per-station anemometer-to-ZMID(1) adjustment / similarity-theory extrapolation

3.when: COMP: the RDUPN AA/BB sounding columns and the VERTAV nine-level averages (fires only when a new sounding is read)

4.when: COMP: immediately before the PREPDI call - the same columns as the analysis consumes them this hour (fires every hour)

binary.order: records are ordered by insertion point, then timestep; each record carries its own (kpt, packed) key

kpt.meaning: record type: 1 entering column, 2 adjusted column, 3 soundings after a new RDUPN read, 4 soundings as PREPDI consumes them

packed.meaning: current timestep beginning time, packed YYYYJJJHH (/GEN/ ndathrb)

iu.meaning: upper-air station index of the dump (kpt=3)

l.meaning: surface station index of the dump (kpt=1,2)

justa.meaning: kpt=4: /UPMET/ justa(1), the AA/BB ordering flag; 0 else

ntzaa.meaning: kpt=4: /UPMET/ ntzaa(1), the AA sounding time YYYYJJJHH

ntzbb.meaning: kpt=4: /UPMET/ ntzbb(1), the BB sounding time YYYYJJJHH

jusdt.meaning: kpt=4: /UPMET/ jusdt(1), the AA/BB separation in seconds

US_ENTER_1..nz.meaning: kpt=1: /D1/ US(k,1) as PREPDI leaves it - the observed surface wind at anemometer height at k=1, EDIT (missing) above; level-major (k, station)

US_ADJUSTED_1..nz.meaning: kpt=2: /D1/ US(k,1) after the station loop (anemometer-to-ZMID(1) / similarity profile)

ZLAA_1..99.meaning: kpt=3: /UPMET/ zlaa(iu,k) - AA sounding heights (station-major array: element (iu,k))

UAVERAA_1..nz.meaning: kpt=3: VERTAV output uaveaa(k,iu) - the AA sounding averaged over each model layer; level-major (k, station)

index_order.UPMET sounding arrays (ZLAA/UAA/VAA/ZLBB: station-major: element (iu,k) - the level index varies fastest
index_order.VERTAV outputs (UAVERAA/VAVERAA/UAVERBB/: level-major: element (k,iu) - the station index varies fastest

missing_sentinel.note: CALMET uses EDIT (=9999.) internally for missing wind components; kpt=1 records show it above level 1, and the sounding arrays may carry 9999.9 for missing levels. The dump writes the raw values, so a reader must treat >=9998. as missing rather than as a physical value.

time.label: packed YYYYJJJHH beginning time (/GEN/ ndathrb) plus seconds (/GEN/ nsecb)
